q: The boss said to the employees, 'Don't waste your time'. (Make it indirect)
o: The boss ordered the employees to not waste their time.
The boss forbade the employees not to waste their time.
The boss advised the employees not to waste their time.
The boss asked the employees to not waste their time.

q: He said to me, "Where were you born?'' (Make indirect)
o: He asked me where I had been born.
He asked me whether I had born.
He asked me where I were born.

q: Rahim said, "Long live Bangladesh!" (Make it indirect)
o: Rahim wished that Bangladesh might live long.
Rahim prayed that may Bangladesh live long.
Rahim prayed Bangladesh to be lived long.
Rahim said that Bangladesh may be live long.

q: John said to me over telephone, “When are you arriving here?” (Make it indirect)
o: John asked me over telephone when was I arriving there.
John asked me over telephone when I was arriving here.
John asked me over telephone when I was arriving there.
John said to me over telephone when I was going there.
e:
Wh-question (When) indirect করতে reporting verb said to হয় asked, প্রশ্নের ক্রম বদলে statement order (subject + verb) হয়, tense এক ধাপ পেছায় এবং here হয় there: John asked me over telephone when I was arriving there. (জন ফোনে আমাকে জিজ্ঞেস করল আমি কখন সেখানে পৌঁছাচ্ছি।)

  • Question-এ said to → asked; প্রশ্নচিহ্ন বাদ যায়।
  • Wh-word-ই joining word, that বসে না।
  • Present continuous (are arriving) → past continuous (was arriving)।
  • Time/place শব্দ বদলায়: here → there, now → then, today → that day।

q: Make it indirect: He said 'I am sorry'.
o: He apologies.
He made an apology.
He make an apology.
He said that he is sorry.

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: Mother said to me, “May you succeed in life.”
o: Mother suggested that I might succeed in life.
Mother told me that I may succeed in life.
Mother said that you might succeed in life.
Mother wished that I might succeed in life.
e:
Mother wished that I might succeed in life বাক্যটি শুদ্ধ, কারণ May you succeed in life আশীর্বাদ বা শুভকামনা প্রকাশক (optative) বাক্য, যার indirect-এ reporting verb হয় wished আর may বদলে might বসে; শ্রোতা you এখানে me, তাই that-এর পরে I থাকে।

  • May দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া optative বাক্যে reporting verb wished বা prayed হয়।
  • Reporting verb past হলে may বদলে might হয়।
  • Pronoun বদল: শ্রোতা (you) বদলে বক্তার দৃষ্টিতে I।

q: He asked me if I had ever been to Darjeeling. (Make it direct)
o: He said to me, “If you have ever been to Darjeeling?”
He said to me, “Have you ever been to Darjeeling?”
He said to me, “Do you ever been to Darjeeling?”
He said to me, “Did you ever been to Darjeeling?”
e:
He said to me, "Have you ever been to Darjeeling?" হলো direct রূপ, কারণ if দিয়ে গঠিত yes/no প্রশ্ন direct করতে asked বদলে said to হয়, if বাদ যায় আর সাধারণ প্রশ্নের মতো auxiliary আগে বসে। Past perfect had ever been বদলে present perfect Have you ever been হয়।

  • Indirect-এর had + past participle direct-এ সাধারণত present perfect (have/has + participle) হয়।
  • Yes/no প্রশ্নে if বা whether থাকে; direct-এ তা বাদ যায় এবং শেষে প্রশ্নচিহ্ন বসে।
  • Indirect-এর I বদলে you হয়, কারণ শ্রোতাকে সরাসরি সম্বোধন করা হয়।
  • Narration-এ pronoun বদলের নিয়ম: First person বক্তার, Second person শ্রোতার, Third person অপরিবর্তিত।
